specification.title: Curve Edit Points And Grips
specification.goal: show and edit freeform control points
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: Line/Polyline/InterpCurve/Circle/Arc/Offset/Fillet/Blend/Rebuild/Match và point edit, G0/G1/G2 theo scope Curve cần cho Matrix.
specification.parent_exclusions: OCCT xử lý hình học, 03 chỉ đưa icon/menu.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Curve Edit Points And Grips” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: geometry fixture checks BRep validity/tolerance/closedness or documented intentional open output.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M03: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Curve Edit Points And Grips”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.
specification.execution_status: SPEC_ONLY; NOT READY TO CODE UNTIL M00 AND TASK L4 AUDIT

technical_decisions: Ưu tiên curve exact qua OCCT Geom_Curve/Geom_BSplineCurve; tessellation chỉ để display không dùng làm dữ liệu nguồn.
Một curve chứa domain, degree, knots, weights, control points, closed flag và tolerance; validate end/periodic, ordering và singularities.
Test endpoints/tangents, projection/intersection/tolerance, serialization và undo; không claim G2 nếu chỉ G1 trên viewport.

input.purpose: show and edit freeform control points
input.representation: analytic/NURBS curve f64, not mesh polyline approximation

positive.setup: Create the geometry and select the inputs required by: show and edit freeform control points
positive.expected: Measured curve endpoints and tangent/parameter domain agree with constructed control points; serialize and reopen without geometry drift.

negative.setup: Try missing/invalid references or cancel during: Curve Edit Points And Grips
negative.expected: Explicit domain error; document IDs, BRep cache, selection and undo journal unchanged

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.input: NURBS with 4 control points, move CP1 by +1 mm in y
golden_test_design.positive_assertions: curve changes predictably; only active feature transaction committed; undo restores original
golden_test_design.negative_assertions: locked curve / out-of-range CP index / invalid change

m03_luna_execution_contract.manual_references_precision: Many references are inherited parent-L2 page ranges, not command-exact citations
invariants: OCCT BRep/Geom is truth for exact geometry; mesh/tessellation only derived
No partial document commit on failure or cancellation
Stable object and subobject identity or explicit broken-reference error
No fabricated test receipts, measured values, or manual review
m03_luna_execution_contract.agent_handoff: Read this L3 first, then precisely one L4 child. Do not start until prerequisite gates and real source available.

focused_test_handoff.parent_golden_positive_oracle: curve changes predictably; only active feature transaction committed; undo restores original
focused_test_handoff.parent_golden_negative_oracle: locked curve / out-of-range CP index / invalid change
focused_test_handoff.independent_domain_example_proposed_not_: degree=2 rational B-spline with control points (0,0),(1,2),(2,0), knots (0,0,0,1,1,1), weights (1,1,1); verify domain u in [0,1]
domain_specific_assertions_to_select_whe: for the illustrative curve only: C(0)=(0,0), C(0.5)=(1,1), C(1)=(2,0)
finite evaluation and derivative continuity in valid parameter domain

negative_cases_to_select_when_applicable: decreasing knots or knot multiplicities incompatible with degree
zero/negative weights where not allowed, NaN, out-of-domain parameter
